rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Republic in exercise of the office of President
rows.text: An unnumbered decree of 11 December 1991, opening a supplementary credit of Cr$ 2,578,453,000.00 in favour of the Presidency, is issued by 'O VICE-PRESIDENTE DA REPÚBLICA, no exercício do cargo de PRESIDENTE DA REPÚBLICA', dated Brasília, 11 December 1991, and signed Itamar Franco (countersigned Marcílio Marques Moreira); the page notes publication in the DOU of 12 December 1991.
